items.name: scheme
items.title: Scheme poster
items.description: Material Theme Builder's color-scheme poster: every M3 role of the theme above it (Scheme) and its tonal palettes (Shades), painted from the CSS variables <Mtb> declares.
items.docs: Render it inside <Mtb> from material-theme-builder/react: <Poster><Scheme theme="light" /><Scheme theme="dark" /><Shades /></Poster>. See https://github.com/abernier/material-theme-builder#scheme-poster
